# Vendored libretro.h

`libretro.h` is a verbatim copy of the libretro API header. Do not edit it. To update it, copy a new version from the source below, change the commit and the checksum in this file, and run `cargo xtask bindgen`.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source | https://github.com/libretro/RetroArch |
| Path | `libretro-common/include/libretro.h` |
| Commit | `b7f61b38be32982ae47066dfa98f036bf9f693ab` (2026-11-09) |
| URL | https://raw.githubusercontent.com/libretro/RetroArch/b7f61b38be32982ae47066dfa98f036bf9f693ab/libretro-common/include/libretro.h |
| SHA-256 | `fdb57ae974bdbe4007af046c8a63f0b5dc25b095a50b1ae99d5d769c2e1033da` |

## Licence

The header carries its own licence text at the top of the file: the MIT licence, "Copyright (C) 2010-2024 The RetroArch team". That licence applies to the header only, not to the rest of RetroArch. The text stays in the file. The generated bindings in `../src/bindings.rs` and `../src/core_api_decls.rs` derive from the header, so the same notice applies to them.
